links.outcome: Reading ease (Flesch-Kincaid) of chatbot and AAO patient education responses
links.effect: AAO website had highest reading ease score (50.4 ± 17.9, p = 0.015); chatbots had higher linguistic complexity, described as a potential accessibility barrier.
links.quote: The AAO website exhibited the highest reading ease score (50.4 ± 17.9, p = 0.015).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, understandability, and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Llama) compared to established professional society resources for patient dry eye education across 20 standardized questions, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
